research_scope: Fresh cross-domain confirmation for the already selected hybrid-window candidate; no parameter tuning is permitted on this source.

source.name: Tatoeba weekly exports
source.quality_limit: Tatoeba states that translation validity and accuracy are not professionally guaranteed; the result must therefore be reported as one noisy crowd-sentence domain, not a broad multilingual benchmark.
source.download_rule: Download only these six files. Before parsing, record byte length and SHA256 for every blob; fail closed on any directory-size mismatch. The mutable weekly URLs become an experimental input only after the downloaded hashes are fixed in a source manifest.

alignment_rule.unit: a fully closed triangle of three sentence IDs with direct eng-fra, eng-spa and fra-spa links
requirements: Every sentence ID exists exactly once in its language file and has the expected ISO 639-3 code.
Every selected triple has all three direct pairwise links; transitive-only triples are ineligible.
All texts are non-empty UTF-8 after stripping only terminal CR/LF; text is otherwise preserved.
No sentence ID may occur in more than one selected triple.
Exact duplicate normalized text within a language is represented only once, using the lowest candidate hash.
alignment_rule.normalization_for_duplicate_and_contamin: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace, strip
alignment_rule.selection: Sort eligible triples by the ordering key, then greedily accept while enforcing sentence-ID and normalized-text uniqueness until 1024 triples are obtained.
alignment_rule.failure_rule: If fewer than 1024 triples remain after all frozen exclusions, stop and report source insufficiency; do not reduce the target or relax the rule after viewing tokenizer outcomes.

independence_and_contamination.training_source: The fixed 100000-pretoken-per-language convenience training payload already used to train all candidate tokenizers.
independence_and_contamination.rule: Before scoring, exclude any candidate sentence whose same-language normalized exact hash matches training or any prior exposed domain, or whose full 5-token normalized shingle multiset containment against one prior item is at least 0.80. Record every exclusion count and hash-only provenance. No tokenizer-derived value participates in this filter.
independence_and_contamination.semantic_limit: This exact/shingle screen cannot prove semantic independence or absence from upstream web training; retain that limitation.

tokenizer_freeze.pretokenizer: Whitespace() then ByteLevel(use_regex=False), identical to prior evaluations
tokenizer_freeze.forbidden: No retraining, parameter change, row replacement, source change or threshold change after any Tatoeba token cost is computed.

primary: aggregate Gini across the three per-language mean token costs
total mean token cost summed across languages
secondary: worst-language mean token cost and identity
per-language mean and integer total token counts
paired bootstrap 95 percent interval for Gini contrasts using a fixed seed recorded before scoring
metrics.independent_verification: A separate evaluator must reconstruct integer costs directly from codes and raw selected text, then recompute all metrics and selection-manifest hashes.

candidate_is_supported_if_all: hybrid_window aggregate Gini is strictly below Classical aggregate Gini
hybrid_window total mean cost is no higher than hybrid total mean cost
confirmation_decision_rule.otherwise: Preserve as a negative or mixed confirmation; do not retune on Tatoeba.
confirmation_decision_rule.interpretation_limit: Passing supports transfer to this one noisy crowd-sentence domain only. It does not establish universal multilingual fairness, downstream quality, or an original-paper reproduction.

information_boundary: The protocol was frozen after TICO candidate selection and before any Tatoeba text blob was downloaded or any tokenizer was scored on Tatoeba. Official directory metadata and licensing/quality statements were inspected only to qualify the source.
